records.name: Philadelphia Trail Club
records.summary: A nonprofit hiking club, founded in 1931, that leads hikes most Saturdays and Sundays. Most hikes run 5 to 10 miles in Philadelphia and the nearby counties.
records.what_you_do: Join a leader on a day hike, sign up as a guest for a public hike, or go on the member only excursions.

schedule.text: Public hikes most Saturdays and Sundays, year round, less often in July and August

locations.label: Hikes in Philadelphia, Bucks, Montgomery, Chester and Delaware counties, sometimes farther

cost.text: Membership dues are $10 a year. The site does not state a fee for public hikes.

first_step.how: Use the non-member hike registration form on the club site, or email the club to ask about the next public hike
first_step.basis: Non-members are welcome on public hikes, and the site links a guest registration form

records.notes: Found through news coverage of Philadelphia hiking clubs after the Meetup topic pages. The club site lists no dated events, so the active status rests on the June 2026 City Cast article. Public hike cost not stated.

records.name: PhillyHikingBeauties
records.summary: A nonprofit women's hiking group in the Philadelphia area. It runs regular hikes, fitness challenges and social outings, and it has a youth program called Little Hiking Beauties.
records.what_you_do: Hike with the group, join the fitness challenges and social outings, or take part in volunteer projects.

schedule.text: Weekly hikes, plus fitness challenges and social outings. The site does not give set days or times in the text I read.

first_step.how: Use the contact page or the events page on the group site to ask about the next hike
first_step.basis: The event list is visible, but the site does not explain how to join or what it costs, so the way in is unclear

records.notes: The site shows no dated events. Its menu links a youth program (Little Hiking Beauties) that was not read. Cost and how to join are not stated on the site. Status rests on the June 2026 City Cast article.

records.name: Isha Foundation Philadelphia program page
records.summary: The Isha Foundation's Philadelphia program page lists free and paid yoga and meditation sessions, but every venue it names is outside the city.
records.notes: Checked 2026-10-08. The listed sessions are at 5620 Derry St in Harrisburg, the Middletown library in Middletown, Delaware, and the Exton Hotel and Conference Center in Exton. None is in Philadelphia. Contact is a Philadelphia team email (Philly@ishausa.org) and phone (484-254-6255). Re-check if a Philadelphia venue is added.
